This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the Japanese-exclusive {{spin-off games}} [[Pokémon Mystery Dungeon (WiiWare)|Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Blazing, Stormy, and Light Adventure Squad]] for the [[Wii]], per the game's [[credits]]. It was published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Chunsoft]].
